articles.image_title: Hitze: Villagers pushed an ailing water buffaloe into a puddle in the mostly dried out Mesopotamian Marshes, Ishan Halab, Iraq, Aug. 15, 2022. Due to Iran and Turkey limiting or stopping waterflow to Iraq, ineffecient watering in northern parts of Iraq and climate change, the marshes are rapidly loosing water and have reached lowest levels since Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein drained the marshes in the early 1990ies.
